subject: Security intake: SIG initiation, data residency and SOC 2 recap
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Avery Lane <avery.lane@finapps.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Security intake: SIG initiation, data residency and SOC 2 recap

Hi Avery — thanks again for the call earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned:

- Redwood contact: Rishi Malhotra (me) — security intake and deal owner
- Goal: kick off vendor security questionnaire and capture SOC 2 status + evidence owners so we can complete the intake by end of month

From our conversation I took away the following:
- FinApps target: embed Redwood for account summarization (P0) and must meet contractual data residency in US/EU
- SOC 2: in progress (you mentioned SOC 2 Type II in progress; please confirm estimated attestation date)
- Preferred questionnaire: you indicated SIG preferred, open to CAIQ if that accelerates things

Requests / asks from our side:
1) Please confirm SOC 2 status and expected attestation quarter/date. If you have a one-page SOC 2 summary (controls mapped) please attach — that speeds review.
2) Confirm the primary security contact for evidence exchange (name + email). I noted security@finapps.com — can you confirm a named owner for specific evidence requests?
3) Data residency nuance: are there any accounts that require EU-only residency, or is US/EU multi-region acceptable?
4) SIG vs CAIQ: confirm preference. If SIG, which modules are in-scope for your environment (data classification, encryption, auth, networking)? If CAIQ is faster for you we can prefill and send.

Attached: short SOC2 summary template (SOC2-summary-2026.pdf) and a SIG starter workbook (SIG-starter.xlsx) we typically prefill for customers — feel free to ignore fields you don't own.

Proposed timeline:
- You confirm items (1)-(3) by EOD Thu 8/20
- We send formal SIG/Caiq prefill and evidence list by 8/21
- Handoff call with security owners Wed 8/21 or Thu 8/22 (please share availability)

If you prefer, we can also run a short 20-minute evidence handoff to speed the process.

Thanks — looking forward to the confirmation.

--
Rishi Malhotra
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

From: Avery Lane <avery.lane@finapps.com>

Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Security intake: SIG initiation, data residency and SOC 2 recap

Thanks Rishi — great summary. A few answers below:

1) SOC 2: We're currently in an internal Type II readiness run. Planned external audit engagement Q4 2026, expected attestation by end of Jan 2027. We do have a short "SOC 2 in progress" one-pager I can share.
2) Primary security contact: I'm CC'ing security@finapps.com (we use the shared mailbox for intake); primary evidence owner will be Jonah Patel (jonah.patel@finapps.com) — he'll own infra and controls evidence.
3) Data residency: For the pilot customers we need US-hosting (us-east) only. EU residency will be required for a subset of later customers; for now mark US as required.
4) Questionnaire: SIG is preferred (we already have some CAIQ work internally). If you can prefill SIG core modules (Auth, Data Protection, Network) that's ideal.

Availability: I can do a 20-minute handoff Fri 8/20 at 10:00am PT or Mon 8/23 afternoon. Jonah will join the call.

Thanks — attaching the SOC note separately.

Best,
Avery

Product Security Manager, FinApps
avery.lane@finapps.com
